newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU finds against French biofuel tax rules.
newsitem.headline: EU finds against French biofuel tax rules.

text.p: BRUSSELS, December 18, Reuter - The European Commission said on Wednesday that tax-exemption measures currently employed by the French government to stimulate biofuel production from raw agricultural products were illegal.
But it might be approved in the future if the exemption system were modified to meet competition and Common Agricultural Policy rules, it said in a statement.
The French measures currently apply solely to domestic raw materials, but not to imported biofuels.

"If France had set out measures for a total exemption for all fuels, there would have been no infringement of either European agricultural policy, or of (competition rules)," the statement said. -- Brussels Newsroom 32 2 287 6800
